scripts.build: npm run build -w @mirasen/chessboard && npm run build -w @mirasen/react-chessboard
scripts.build:release: npm run build:release -w @mirasen/chessboard && npm run build:release -w @mirasen/react-chessboard
scripts.check: npm run build:core && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.coverage: npm run build:core && npm run coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.changeset:version: changeset version && npm install && npm run format && git add --all
